text:
Mina: quick Q  I ended the year with 6 PTO days. My lead said I can carry over up to 5 but Im not sure what happens to the 6th. Is it auto-forfeited or paid out? Also our team plans a voluntary Jan 4 "office unwind" day  can I apply carryover to that?

Jordan (People Ops): thanks Mina. short answers: up to 5 days automatically eligible for carryover if requested; any days above your carryover cap are subject to local policy - in most locations we do not auto-payout unless you separate from the company. You must submit a carryover request in Workday and indicate if you want the excess to be considered for payout (payroll will review separations only). Voluntary team days are not company shutdowns; you can request to use PTO/carryover for them but you need manager approval.

Mina: got it. who sets the carryover cap? is it global or local?

Jordan (People Ops): carryover cap is global default = 5 days, but local statutory rules override (e.g., some EU countries require unlimited carryover for sick time or longer windows). If youre under a local law that changes caps, Workday will show the adjusted allowance. If it looks off, attach your local contract or ask us.

Leah: small nuance: Im converting to full-time Jan 10 (was contractor before). Can I carryover days accrued as contractor?

Jordan (People Ops): contractor accruals generally dont convert. If you were on a fixed-term employee contract with accruals, well honor it. Please open a ticket with HR-Admin and include your contract type; well route for payroll/legal review.

HR-Admin: Filed case HR-6241 for Leah (contract->employee carryover review). Please attach contract PDF.

people_ops_bot: Reminder: Payroll cutoff for carryover processing: Dec 20 23:59 UTC. Requests submitted after cutoff will be processed manually in Jan and may delay availability. <https://hr.example.com/carryover-policy>

Mina: thanks all  Ill submit in Workday and tag Jordan when done.

Jordan (People Ops): perfect, tag us and well confirm. If you want to use carryover for the Jan 4 team day, include the date in your request so managers can approve promptly. :thumbsup:
